result.summary: Prevents a division-by-zero crash when calling CFeeRate::GetFeePerK() on a zero-sized fee rate. If the fee rate is empty, GetFeePerK() now returns zero instead of evaluating fees down to 1000 vbytes, matching the behavior of GetFee().
result.problem: Constructing a CFeeRate with zero size causes subsequent calls to GetFeePerK() or CFeeRate::operator+= to unconditionally call EvaluateFeeDown(1000), resulting in a division by zero that crashes the node.
evidence: A CFeeRate with size 0 GetFeePerK() and CFeeRate+= evaluated EvaluateFeeDown(1000) unconditionally, dividing by that zero size and crashing (PR description)
This was reported by Jacob F Cudney (aragondragon) (PR description)
result.card: Prevents an unhandled division-by-zero crash in CFeeRate when calling GetFeePerK() on a zero-sized rate. An empty fee rate now returns zero instead of dividing by zero in EvaluateFeeDown(1000), matching the behavior of GetFee(). This also fixes crashes when using operator+= on empty fee rates and adds unit test coverage. Reported by Jacob F Cudney.

risk.why: Incorrect return values or logic errors in CFeeRate could corrupt fee calculations or comparisons across mempool policy and wallet operations.
